result.title: Left-Right-Consistent Iterative Stereo Matching via Cross-Injection
result.summary: State-of-the-art stereo matching models predominantly predict the disparity of only the left (reference) view. However, applications such as per-eye AR/VR rendering, novel view synthesis, or two-view depth fusion require disparity for both views, and need those two maps to agree. The usual workaround of running the network a second time on the horizontally flipped and swapped pair gives two independent predictions that can be inconsistent, especially on transparent surfaces, in textureless regions, and at occlusion boundaries. We introduce cross-injection (CI), a lightweight extension for iterative (refinement-based) models that can be added to any pretrained left-only iterative matcher. It couples the two passes by injecting the explicit, signed left-right inconsistency as an additional input cue at every step of the refinement stage. We empirically show that CI substantially reduces left-right disagreement on every benchmark (more than halving it on Booster for FoundationStereo), while largely preserving sharp object boundaries. Furthermore, using two state-of-the-art stereo matching models, we show that CI also reduces the single-view disparity error, making it a worthwhile extension even if only left disparity is needed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对立体匹配只预测左视图视差的问题，提出 cross-injection（CI）：在迭代精化模型的每一步中，把显式的左右不一致量（带符号）作为额外输入注入，使左右两次预测相互耦合。实验显示该方法在多个基准上显著降低左右不一致，并基本保持物体边界锐利，同时也能降低单视图视差误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“把显式的不一致/校验信号逐步回注到迭代状态更新中”的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与循环推理状态的误差反馈提供可核查线索，但该论文面向立体匹配，未涉及 latent 推理。
